snippet.title: Telwynium Demo Announcement Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Powerhoof's fantasy adventure epic The Telwynium is coming to Steam.

The Telwynium began as a series of free instalments, leaning heavily on our nostalgia for cheesy fantasy novels and early point 'n clicks, now brought together on Steam in its final form, as a single epic adventure! 

Book One "Winter's Dawn" is available right now as a free playable demo on Steam.

THE STORY:
 
Your home, the village of Willows Dene, burns at the hands of the shadowfell. 

Only the power of the Autumn-Aldor Dwinn stopped it from being overrun completely. Now, led by the Aldor, you flee to the west for the White City, Aldarris. With you are your childhood friends Tani and Witt, the irritable Uplander Otarr Stronghorn, and a colossal gohl'en of mud and stone, summoned by the Aldor as the shadowfell attacked.

It is your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

THE FEATURES:
- A warm blanket of nostalgia to wrap around yourself!
- All those lovely cliché fantasy tropes, with the twists and turns you'd expect from the writer of The Drifter.
- Play as multiple characters and wield the powers of sorcerers, necromancers, and rogues.
- 16 color EGA artwork- presented in glorious 4:3 with a selection of CRT filters.
- Streamlined 90s point 'n clicking- You won't find soft-locks or unfair deaths- but you'll need to look carefully at your surroundings!
- Authentic Roland MT32 Soundtrack from composer Brandon Blume.
- Build yourself a skeleton army!

Wishlist the Telwynium Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818820/The_Telwynium/
